method: Original closed boot pairs adapt the existing owned hollow footwear anatomy with original soles, heels and exposed lining. Original armor cap/strap/trim/cloth shapes reuse owned leather, metal, gold and a fully opaque blue sample from the original magic-boot icon. No raster generation/edit.
limitations: Simplified caps, straps, buckles, trim and static blue cloth; fixed paired pose; omitted fine ornament; no worn modular fitting or author acceptance.
iterations: Independent geometry checks caught a magic-boot pair 2.65 source-scale pixels wider than its effective sprite. A 3% horizontal fit of that pair brings the model within the unchanged artwork envelope; collision and scale remain unchanged. Native review also replaced solid buckle plates with open frames/pins and increased curved shin-plate subdivisions/clearance, attaching raised gold marks to the plates instead of hiding them against the underlying upper.
